name: Stipends to Students of Minority Caste for Technical and Vocational Courses after SSC
benefit: - **Stipend:** A monthly stipend of ₹400/- is given to Minority Caste students for one year of recognized professional and Government ITI courses.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should belong to Minority Caste. 1. The applicant should be a student who has passed the Secondary School Certificate (SSC) examination. 1. The applicant should be enrolled in a recognized professional or Government Industrial Training Institute (ITI) course. 1. The applicant’s individual and family income should not exceed ₹6,00,000/- per annum.
